1.consolidated_definition: Residuo, escombros. El remanente de algo roto o destruido. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Sin embargo, en general en el interior de un sistema cavernario extenso no vas a recibir un golpe de agua, el nivel del río subirá rápidamente, lo que pudiera comenzar a ocurrir aun sin turbidez ni debris, material vegetal como hojarasca y ramas. Esto es por que la cueva sirve de disipador de energía y trampa de sedimento (Sociedad Espeleológica de PR, 02-03-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Remnant, rubble. The remaining portion of something broken or destroyed. Raw anglicism, relatively uncommon. However, within the interior of an extensive cave system, you will not receive a water impact, as the river level will rise rapidly, which could begin to occur even without turbidity or debris, such as leaf litter and branches. This is because the cave serves as an energy dissipator and sediment trap (Puerto Rico Cave Society, 02-03-08)
